technicalNotes:
Bu arıza kodu şu modülde görüldüğünde: VW Passat (3C): Parking Fren:
Clear Fault Codes with Engine running (to ensure proper Voltage Supply). When checking Voltage with this Fault Code stored, the Module may not output Power to the Motor. Try clearing Fault Codes and Operating the EPB as mentioned below before testing again.
Switch Ignition OFF for about 10 Seconds
Start the Engine and keep it running while trying to clear Fault Codes.
Press the Parking Fren Button (E538) in 5 Second Intervals.
Kontrol edin:  TPI 2013530 (Rest of World) or TSB 2015075/01-07-47 (North American Region) for possible Kontrol Modülü Software Update which corrects Low Voltage Sensitivity. This Update can be considered mandatory if you have these Fault Codes stored!
